arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
src=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-verified-release.XXXXXX)
archive=/opt/telegram-robot-leads/.telegram-leads-release-45b085c788814c481d6c7922cf7789c144109f9c.tgz
trap 'sudo -n rm -f -- "$archive"; rm -rf -- "$src"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$src"
test "$(git -C "$src" rev-parse HEAD)" = "45b085c788814c481d6c7922cf7789c144109f9c"
python3 -B - "$src" <<'PY'
import importlib.util,tarfile,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1])
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("installer",p/"scripts/deploy_project_only.py")
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
assert "scripts/public_group_discovery.py" in mod.RUNTIME_FILES
with tarfile.open(p/"runtime.tgz","w:gz") as tar:
 for name in mod.RUNTIME_FILES:
  f=p/name;assert f.is_file() and not f.is_symlink()
  tar.add(f,arcname=name,recursive=False)
print("RELEASE_FILE_COUNT",len(mod.RUNTIME_FILES),flush=True)
PY
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 600 "$src/runtime.tgz" "$archive"
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B "$src/scripts/deploy_project_only.py" --bundle "$archive" --commit "45b085c788814c481d6c7922cf7789c144109f9c" --expected-installed "655a911595fd49b0eaeb4feec4dc5a0fb4ac61e0" --apply --confirm-telegram-only
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B /opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts/project_hygiene.py --apply --confirm-telegram-only
sudo -n -H env PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2 TELEGRAM_REGIONAL_PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=1 pm2 restart telegram-robot-leads --update-env
sudo -n env PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2 pm2 jlist | python3 -c 'import json,sys; rows=json.load(sys.stdin); workers=[x for x in rows if x.get("name")=="telegram-robot-leads"]; assert len(workers)==1; meta=workers[0]["pm2_env"]; assert meta.get("status")=="online" and meta.get("pm_exec_path")=="/opt/telegram-robot-leads/main.py"; assert meta.get("TELEGRAM_REGIONAL_PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED")=="1"; print("TARGET_WORKER_ONLINE",True,"REGIONAL_ENABLED",True,"RESTARTS",meta.get("restart_time"))'
test "$(sudo -n cat /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.verified-source-commit)" = "45b085c788814c481d6c7922cf7789c144109f9c"
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B /opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts/leads_operational_report.py --expected-source "45b085c788814c481d6c7922cf7789c144109f9c" --with-pm2 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); assert r["source"]["matches_expected"] is True; assert r["sessions"]["accounts"]==2; assert r["pm2"]["status"]=="ONLINE"; print("OPERATIONAL_REPORT",r["status"],"SESSIONS",r["sessions"]["accounts"],"PM2",r["pm2"]["status"],"GROWTH_MODEL",r.get("organic_growth_model",{}).get("owned_channel_promotion"))'
echo TELEGRAM_LEADS_RELEASE_VERIFIED
